combos.why: Patterns that suit it: plain stripes or bands: calm lines against the scatter; dark gradient fades: focus the lines on one area

Spec overlays that work: gloss/matte bands: more depth to the dark ground; fine flake: tiny amount for extra glint
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

articles.title: Shearography
articles.summary: Dark teal-green satin with faint crinkled leaf-like texture, like hammered or veined metal. Reads as a dark navy-black car covered in a pink-magenta and violet swirl-ring print with teal flecks; individual rings blur into a busy wallpaper.

Colored inspection artwork with positive fringes, negative fringes, null seams, coherent grains, disbond Up close: Overlapping oval fringe rings, like fingerprints or topographic contours, in pink-coral and violet, each about 30-50 px across and tilted at random angles. Short straight teal slashes cut through them and tiny gold dots dust the navy-black ground between. From a distance: Reads as a dark navy-black car covered in a pink-magenta and violet swirl-ring print with teal flecks; individual rings blur into a busy wallpaper.
